method: native ARM64 compile of exact frozen C++20 module exports plus thin input/output adapter
normalizedInput: same raw logged positions*.5 system DIP; original QPC and per-consume-frame grouping; frame=max(logged frame,newest batch sample), matching production CanvasPanInput
unitsCaveat: legacy-default-DIP kernels do not gain physical profiles; mm equivalent is only post-hoc output conversion, not their original unit
integrationCaveat: no Controller/RTS/GPU or physical device replay; no actual applied-delta feedback; final-frame delta may contain old-version initial coast, so consumedDeltaDip is not universally pure held movement
adapterCorrection: first-run outputs archived adapter-v1-before-frame-normalization.json; superseded after adding production max(frame,newestSampleQpc) normalization
